n: Black Sails: Curse of the Deep
ld:
This is a quick beta demonstration of part of the combat system that would be intended for the full game: where you will be an upstart pirate who has to break the curse of being a Ghost Pirate!
Black Sails is intended to be a combination of Assassins Creed: Pirates for mobile, with the humour and storytelling of Monkey Island, and the vibe of the likes of Alestorm or Pirates of the Caribbean!

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
